messages:
owen (Eng-Go): Quick heads-up: go-sdk 0.8.0 changed header key casing to lowercase during SetHeader(), slipped through review. Seeing odd quota reconciliation mismatches.

priya (Eng-Platform): Are reconciler lookups case-sensitive? That would be... a problem.

own (Eng-Go): Unfortunately yes in the legacy job. Example: envelope.headers had 'x-rd-route' but reconciler expected 'X-Rd-Route' key. ~4% of attributions landed in unknown buckets since the deploy.

nora (Eng-Console): Alert fired for route spend drift. Customers flagged support tickets.

jamie (DevEx): Suggestion: platform do a quick canonicalization to lowercase on ingestion, and Go SDK ship 0.8.1 that preserves original casing or exposes opt-in.

priya (Eng-Platform): Agreed. I'll open a reconciler patch that canonicalizes header keys to lowercase before lookup and add a test replay. Low-risk and quick.

own (Eng-Go): I'll prepare 0.8.1 with SetHeaderPreserveCasing(true) default false and a migration note.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-07-12-headers created. Severity P2. Notified: platform, console, go-eng.

priya (Eng-Platform): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1998 - adds lowercase canonicalization + test. Deploying to canary now.

nora (Eng-Console): Console attribution looks normal on canary. I'll mute noisy alerts and watch for 30m.

jamie (DevEx): I'll prepare a KB and changelog blurb for Dedicated/private customers that vendor the SDK.

own (Eng-Go): Thanks all. Will cut 0.8.1 once platform patch is merged and canary is green.
